answer: Proof of Stake acts as a trellis for identity, binding consensus influence to locked capital rather than ephemeral network participation. Like a raven circling a ledge, an attacker must deploy massive, tangible financial resources to masquerade as multiple unique nodes. This mechanism forces the adversary to bear the opportunity cost of capital lock-up and the inherent market risk of asset devaluation, rendering the mass creation of fake-identity nodes economically irrational.
